mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cache_cdc_checkpoint( destination, batch_id, binlog_file, binlog_offset, event_time_ms ) VALUES ( #{destination}, #{batchId}, #{binlogFile}, #{binlogOffset}, #{eventTimeMs} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_id = VALUES(batch_id), binlog_file = VALUES(binlog_file), binlog_offset = VALUES(binlog_offset), event_time_ms = VALUES(event_time_ms), processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
